import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    a = list(map(int, data[1:1 + n]))
    # Using quickselect algorithm via nth_element equivalent
    # Sort the first n//2+1 elements (or simply use statistics.median)
    # But to exactly match nth_element behavior (partial sort), we sort the whole list and take median
    a.sort()
    print(a[n // 2])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
